title: Herbal Juicy Uruguayan Soy Stew
description: A hearty and energizing Uruguayan-inspired stew featuring soy milk, halal-friendly and infused with herbal flavors. This dish is perfect for a cold evening, providing a boost of warmth and energy.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped parsley, cilantro, and crushed oregano. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the soy milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chimichurri sauce and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Let the stew simmer for an additional 5 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
